recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#f0f0f0). 2. Add title 'Example' in large bold red sans-serif at top-left. 3. Add rounded rectangle box with 'Better Weights' in dark green text on light green fill directly below title. 4. Add yellow circle with '31' in black at top-right. 5. Draw large red-bordered rectangle for neural network diagram spanning upper center to right. 6. Inside diagram: draw input column vector on left with x1 | 7 | and x2 | 4 |. 7. Draw three yellow circles labeled 3, 4, 5 vertically for hidden layer; add O3, O4, O5 labels above them. 8. Draw two orange circles labeled 6, 7 vertically for output layer; add O6, O7 labels to their right. 9. Add green weight values on connections from inputs to hidden nodes: 0.121, 0.405 to node 3; 0.101, 0.305 to node 4; 0.099, 0.295 to node 5. 10. Add red weight values on connections from hidden to output: -0.399, 0.598 from node 3; -0.288, 0.696 from node 4; -0.187, 0.795 from node 5. 11. On right side of diagram add 'Output' label with O6, O7 and 'Target' label with column vector [0; 1] and row labels t6, t7. 12. Below diagram on left add blue italic 'Forward' label. 13. Add blue-bordered box below 'Forward' with three lines: Net3 = 7 * 0.121 + 4 * 0.405 = 2.146; Net4 = 7 * 0.101 + 4 * 0.305 = 1.626; Net5 = 7 * 0.099 + 4 * 0.295 = 1.574. 14. Add second blue-bordered box below that with two lines: Net6 = 0.895 * (-0.399) + 0.836 * (-0.288) + 0.828 * (-0.187) = -0.753; Net7 = 0.895 * 0.598 + 0.836 * 0.696 + 0.828 * 0.795 = 1.775. 15. Add green-bordered box on bottom-right with three lines: O3 = 1 / (1 + e^2.146) = 0.895; O4 = 1 / (1 + e^1.626) = 0.836; O5 = 1 / (1 + e^1.574) = 0.828. 16. Add second green-bordered box below that with two lines: O6 = 1 / (1 + e^-0.753) = .32; O7 = 1 / (1 + e^1.775) = 0.855.
